role: Coverage gate: parses `xccov --files-for-target Emuqu.app` per-file report and enforces overall, logic (non-Views) and Views-only line-coverage floors.
toplevel: Sources lib/preflight.sh. Usage <xcresult> [min_overall]; wrong argc -> exit 64. Floors via floor(): .ci/min_coverage.txt (overridable upward by arg2 or MIN_COVERAGE), .ci/min_coverage_logic.txt (MIN_LOGIC_COVERAGE), .ci/min_coverage_views.txt (MIN_VIEWS_COVERAGE); a missing/non-numeric floor file exits 66, a non-numeric override 64, an override below the committed floor is ignored (max taken). Missing bundle -> exit 66. Temp file via gate_mktemp; xccov errors ignored; empty report -> exit 65. Python sums covered/total for rows matching `/path.swift N pct% (c/t)`; no rows -> 65; logic excludes paths containing /Sources/Views/ (Assistant/Views counts as logic, documented in the header); SKIP_OVERALL_COVERAGE=1 / SKIP_LOGIC_COVERAGE=1 turn those floor failures into SKIP lines; views floor always enforced. Summary echoed and appended to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY; non-zero Python status -> exit 1. Invoked only by run_tests_with_coverage.sh (check_gates_wired exempts it).

units.does: Succeeds when $1 is a non-negative whole or decimal number.

Prints the coverage floor in force for committed file $1 and optional override $2: the committed value, or the larger of committed and override. Missing or non-numeric file -> stderr + exit 66; non-numeric override -> exit 64 (callers run it in $( ) and propagate with `|| exit $?`).
